source: data/frames — JTVFX TNG title-sequence re-creation, 1920x1080, 2742 frames
conventions: frames 0-indexed; coordinates normalized 0..1, origin top-left, x right, y down

fields.cx/cy: area-weighted centroid of the lit non-title mass
fields.w/h: bounding box of that mass, as a fraction of the frame
fields.area: lit pixels as a fraction of the frame
fields.angle: principal axis in degrees, 0-180; absent when elong < 1.6 (degenerate)
fields.elong: major/minor axis ratio of the same moment fit; 99 means a line
fields.aspect: bounding-box h/w, independent of the moment fit
fields.nacelle_a/b: blue warp-grille glow blobs, ordered left-to-right in x; absent when unlit
fields.accent: area-weighted centroid of the red-orange impulse/deflector glow

caveats: The subject is the *lit* mass: on a planet pass it is the planet, not the hull.
On the Earth and eclipse shots the nacelle columns pick up the sun's halo and the atmosphere rim (f150 reports a blob at (0.438, 0.430) — that is the sun on its measured mark).
f253-260 is the reference's foreground moon veil, which the recreation deliberately does not stage.
